content_units: EUR to USD This Week: Overall Direction
It was generally getting   more expensive in EUR terms to buy USD   over the week.
- The table shows   EURUSD  , which means   how many USD you get for 1 EUR  .
- When this number goes   up  , your EUR buys   more USD  , so buying USD becomes   cheaper   for someone starting with EUR.
- When this number goes   down  , your EUR buys   fewer USD  , so buying USD becomes   more expensive  .

Across the week, the rate moved from   1.071   on 2026-03-02 to   1.091   on 2026-03-06, so by the end of the week it was   cheaper overall   to buy USD with EUR, even though there were small day-to-day dips.
